dedupe_keys.name: google pixel 5 and u blox f9p repeated static gnss canopy measurements

description: This collection compares simultaneous raw GNSS observations from a Google Pixel 5 smartphone and a u-Blox ZED F9P receiver near Technical University in Zvolen, Slovakia. Twenty-minute measurements repeat at open, partial-canopy and full-canopy points, with ten measurement days under leaf-on conditions and ten under leaf-off conditions. Mendeley version 3 makes the data free under CC BY 4.0. The article identifies RINEX observations and navigation files, u-Blox logging files, reference coordinates and supporting postprocessing configuration and Python scripts. Coverage is controlled static positioning, with exact acquisition dates unestablished here. Selected receivers and vegetation states are limitations for moving-platform accuracy estimates. Modellers could compare low-cost receiver and canopy-error assumptions in positioning-dependent transport or field-equipment simulations. model-pyrtklib is a related processing resource, and data-google-smartphone-decimeter-gnss-datasets offers a different mobile benchmark. No observation file, receiver driver or postprocessing script was downloaded or executed.
